mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CONTRACT_REVIEW_CLAUSE_VALUE (VALUE_ID, COMPARISON_ID, RUN_ID, SIDE_KEY, SOURCE_FILE_ID, STATE, SCENARIO_KEY, RESPONSIBLE_PARTY, CALCULATION_BASIS, RATE_VALUE, RATE_UNIT, FREQUENCY, PERIOD_VALUE, CAP_RATE, CAP_AMOUNT, TERMINATION_THRESHOLD, DATE_TYPE, NORMALIZED_DATE, TERM_START, DURATION_VALUE, EFFECTIVE_CONDITION, TERMINATION_CONDITION) VALUES (#{row.valueId}, #{row.comparisonId}, #{row.runId}, #{row.sideKey}, #{row.sourceFileId}, #{row.state}, #{row.scenarioKey}, #{row.responsibleParty}, #{row.calculationBasis}, #{row.rateValue}, #{row.rateUnit}, #{row.frequency}, #{row.periodValue}, #{row.capRate}, #{row.capAmount}, #{row.terminationThreshold}, #{row.dateType}, #{row.normalizedDate}, #{row.termStart}, #{row.durationValue}, #{row.effectiveCondition}, #{row.terminationCondition})

SELECT V.VALUE_ID, V.COMPARISON_ID, V.RUN_ID, V.SIDE_KEY, V.SOURCE_FILE_ID, V.STATE, V.SCENARIO_KEY, V.RESPONSIBLE_PARTY, V.CALCULATION_BASIS, V.RATE_VALUE, V.RATE_UNIT, V.FREQUENCY, V.PERIOD_VALUE, V.CAP_RATE, V.CAP_AMOUNT, V.TERMINATION_THRESHOLD, V.DATE_TYPE, V.NORMALIZED_DATE, V.TERM_START, V.DURATION_VALUE, V.EFFECTIVE_CONDITION, V.TERMINATION_CONDITION, E.EVIDENCE_ID FROM CONTRACT_REVIEW_CLAUSE_VALUE V LEFT JOIN CONTRACT_REVIEW_CLAUSE_VALUE_EVIDENCE E ON E.VALUE_ID=V.VALUE_ID WHERE V.COMPARISON_ID=#{comparisonId} ORDER BY V.SIDE_KEY, V.VALUE_ID, E.EVIDENCE_ID
